goal_reference: GOAL.md milestone table: debug-truth combination with online depth mapping, EGO, and PX4 flight closed loop; not final vision acceptance.

exit_checks.criterion: A single debug_truth epoch feeds mapping, EGO navigation and PX4 bridge.
exit_checks.evidence: Run #34 epoch 48e93e55e6934b83aac5626e65f35d51 is shared by the live map input, action goal and 938 READY PositionCommand samples.

exit_checks.criterion: D435i depth reaches the live EGO occupancy mapper.
exit_checks.evidence: Run #34 observed 408 occupied points before enable, 192 occupancy clouds and a peak of 2,047 points.

exit_checks.criterion: EGO produces a goal-bound trajectory that PX4 tracks.
exit_checks.evidence: Navigation action succeeded with position_yaw_tolerance_held; the same goal_id/epoch appeared in 938 READY PositionCommand samples. The sole /position_cmd publisher is traj_server; PX4 bridge was the sole publisher for each of the four PX4 input topics.

exit_checks.criterion: PX4 EKF2 consumes the bridge external odometry and completes a controlled flight.
exit_checks.evidence: The #34 ULog records 808 vehicle_visual_odometry inputs, EV position/velocity/yaw aid fusion, Offboard and trajectory setpoints, arm at 14.960 s, disarm at 34.004 s, no failsafe samples, and final landed/disarmed bridge state. EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0, SIM_GZ_EN_ODOM=0, and logged GNSS aiding flags are zero.

exit_checks.criterion: Run remains isolated to the debug-truth profile and does not claim final vision qualification.
exit_checks.evidence: All runtime localization paths are remapped under /debug_truth; this is explicitly a debug profile. Raw SITL GPS sensors exist and no obstacle was deliberately inserted.

limitations: This route did not test obstacle clearance or avoidance; that remains part of later navigation acceptance.
The run uses Gazebo truth for map pose, task pose and PX4 external odometry. It cannot satisfy final visual/no-truth requirements.
This does not complete GOAL A-H. P4 remains in progress; P5 and P6 have not started.
